OUR APPROACH

The line is set before the foundation is poured.

Before a single foundation is poured, a surveyor sets out the alignment. Nothing built off the line can be fixed cheaply later. That is exactly what we sell — and exactly how we build the firm.

WE DO

The neutral side
of the table.

  • Design dispute-resolution systems into contracts and relationships
  • Sit as mediator, conciliator, facilitator, standing neutral, adjudicator, arbitrator
  • Audit live projects and relationships for conflict risk
  • Train, certify and publish
  • Administer cases as an institution (registry, panels, rules, fee scales)

WE DO NOT

Anything
adversarial.

  • Act as counsel in litigation or arbitration for any party
  • Draft pleadings, issue legal notices, or advise one side on merits
  • Take contingency or outcome-linked fees in any neutral role
  • Accept work where a founder, spouse or empanelled neutral has any interest
  • Comment publicly on any live matter, ever

We never act for one side.
That is the entire point.
